name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate mechanics of his father’s small automotive repair shop in Seoul. Inspired by the precision and engineering excellence of Formula One, he pursued a degree in mechanical engineering and dedicated himself to mastering the art of race car performance. His career started in the Korean touring car championship before he moved to Europe where he quickly built a reputation for his meticulous data analysis and innovative problem-solving during his time with several European racing teams.

Park's approach to race engineering is rooted in a holistic understanding of the vehicle dynamics and driver feedback. He believes that the key to success lies in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers and drivers can openly communicate and refine strategies together. What sets Park apart is his ability to visualize the entire race from a system perspective, anticipating potential issues and developing proactive solutions, making him a valuable asset for any team aiming for championship success. He is now looking for a new challenge to apply his expertise.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Park is a slender man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Insists on drinking green tea before every practice session.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
